# apple_game_center_leaderboards (Data Source)

Lists the Game Center leaderboards of an app or of a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_leaderboards" "app" {
  game_center_detail_id = data.apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  archived              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) `true` lists only archived leaderboards, `false` only the others. Unset lists every leaderboard.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app's Game Center detail. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `leaderboards` (Attributes List) The leaderboards. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--leaderboards))

<a id="nestedatt--leaderboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `leaderboards`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the leaderboard is archived.
- `default_formatter` (String) How scores are shown.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard.
- `recurrence_rule` (String) How often a recurring leaderboard starts over. Null for a classic leaderboard.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the leaderboard in App Store Connect.
- `score_sort_type` (String) Whether high (`DESC`) or low (`ASC`) scores rank first.
- `submission_type` (String) Which of a player's scores counts: `BEST_SCORE`, `MOST_RECENT_SCORE`.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game reports scores with.
